reviewer: orchestrator (Claude), under DEC-033's delegation; the lead chose Q14 option D (DEC-060)
rule_reviewed: Waive a blocking event only if its exact reason is ordinary_text_training_prefix or development_drift_text, it has nonempty ordinary text, and it carries no subject or waiver-subject annotation; keep every edit / answer / paraphrase / locality / near / revision / composition or ambiguous query context and every direct subject reservation; cross-dataset names are not inferred homonyms; no teacher result or outcome enters the rule.
decision: ADOPTED as an outcome-independent rule. Rationale: a mention inside an ordinary-text training window or a drift window is pretraining-style text exposure of the base, not editing or query exposure of a subject by the reader or the evaluation; the register's purpose (DEC-041/048) is to exclude subjects the system was taught or asked about, and these events are neither. Everything task-specific stays excluded.
limits_acknowledged: preteacher and pre-role counts; the teacher pass and role allocation may reduce them
exposure as of commit 2a8b237; a supplement for later exposure is required before clearance
the rule does not establish subjects unseen by the base model; it distinguishes text exposure from editing exposure
next: Codex promotes candidate v5 to an operative evidence resource bound to this review (lane R1-D10g), with the later-exposure supplement; roles and teacher eligibility are regenerated from it.
